teks: If every copy of GTA 5 ever sold was stacked up, how tall would the pile be?
Guess first! A, 32 kilometers. B, 322 kilometers. Or C, 3,220 kilometers.
According to Take-Two, GTA 5 has sold more than 230 million copies.
Assume every copy is a physical one, and one game case is 1.4 centimeters thick.
So 230 million times 1.4 centimeters gives 3,220 kilometers.
The International Space Station orbits about 400 kilometers up. The answer is C, a stack eight times higher than the ISS!
